snippet.title: The Bodega Court of Salty DQs: Amai Edition - Visual Novel Release Trailer - Free Game Download
snippet.description:
Become the best tennis player in the world so that you can save some restaurant down the street operated by homie thugs. When there's no other way to pay off a $2 million dollar repair fee, and your boss gets turned into a skeleton, the only way out of this is to win a tennis tournament! Lucky for the Mad Meats restaurant, they happen to have a tennis player as one of their goons! It's time for Dennis the tennis player to shine in this supercalifragilisticexpialidocious, non horror visual novel adventure, other than the horrors of the usual 1 million explosions you see in our games.

Download Link: https://chairgtables.itch.io/bodega-court

This game features the voice talents of
Shadowpilot6: https://twitter.com/The_PatrickC_VO
Will Greiner: https://willgreinerva.carrd.co/
KeyAndEnter: https://twitter.com/keyandenter
Marielle Collins: https://twitter.com/MariVoices
Cali: https://twitter.com/calistaiman
Rhawel Edith Mikage: https://twitter.com/RhawelVA
ChairGTables: https://twitter.com/ChairGTables
Cheryl: https://twitter.com/cheryl_sherirun
Harley K Rathaway: https://twitter.com/HostbustersHKR
LilacHylia: https://twitter.com/LilacHyliaVO
Noelle Magyar
Jacob  
Eliara

Music used in this trailer is from PeriTune

I think voice acting is one of the coolest things ever. Like you can go crazy, and it feels like it's embarassing to do, but if you embrace being silly as much as possible, you can make any character feel like they can come alive. I've always loved doing shoryukens IRL at school and yelling out all the move names, even though everyone just stares at me weirdly. But, hey that's still cool right many years down the line? Right? AaaaaaHAhahahaaaaaaaaaaaAhghGHGHGHghAAHGhhA!! Let's goooooooooooo!!!!! Screaming out fighting game moves is like super cool, it makes you feel so alive. BODY GA AMAI ZE!! Whether it's Kyo Kusanagi from the King of Fighters series, or just screaming out SHORYKEN everytime like a real Ken Street Fighter player in the FGC, always have fun. I only voice acted for small side roles for this one lol, I really just wanted to see all my friends' potential here. O since you're still reading, there's a secret in the files. You can go to the audio folder and there's a chair only folder and you can copy and paste that to the folder above if you want to hear the first half of the game voice acted with all the characters by me lol, but of course play the base game first because everyone's voices here are super duper mega giga awesome and you gotta hear everyone before they all become the legends of the future. But yes, this is probably the first fully voice acted game we did. We had voices for other games like Super Ledgehop, Hazuki Dies, etc. but they're usually only during battle sequences. It's super cool finally seeing all the dialogue being read out. Btw if you're working on any projects and need any voices pls look for any of the people voicing this game. This game is essentially one of the starting points of our voice acting journey and it'll be super cool if we can grow alongside yall. Dude like ok, you can also pick me if you just want to make a video where you find a toilet out in the forest and you end up finding a boulder at a volcano, and you wanna see how toilets explode, dude literally ask me and i'll voice the toilet goign UUUUuuuWAAAAARRRRRRRGGHHHHHHH or even the boulder you find at tthe volcano I can make him have like the biggest speech as he delivers the spectacular finishing blow as he crashes down the toilet with the TAKE THIS ULTIMATE CRASHING EARTH SHATTERING BLOW TSUUUUROOOOOOOOYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
KABOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM 
GWAAAAAAAAHHAHAHAHAHAHAH AHAHAHAHAHHAH AHAH AH HA HA HA HAHHAHA HAH AH HAHA HA H AH AH AH HA!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

It’s the Nutshack! (Oh Yea!, Yeeeah Yah-Yahe)

It’s the Nutshack! (Hey, I'm in that, It's the Nutshack..)

It’s the Nutshack! (Don't forget ya boy Angel!)

It’s the Nutshack! (It’s the Nutshack!)

It’s the Nutshack! (It’s the Nutshack! Rainbow Scout..)

It’s the Nutshack! (Hey dude, you got? Dude, It's the Nutshack..)

It’s the Nutshack! (Hey!, *possibly Angel*: You guys my home!)

It’s the Nutshack! (This beat's knockin'!,It's the Nutshack..)

It’s the Nutshack! (Wow!, Yeeeah!, It's the Nutshack.., It's the Nutshack!)

It’s the Nutshack! (Hoo-ugh!, Let's get this crackin')


Phil’s from the Soul, Jack’s from the P.I. (P.I.!)

Horatio or Horat so big-eyed!


Tito Dick, “Dickman”, baby!, He raised Phil and loves the ladies. Jack’s is cool and he's lazy, he’s still learnin’

On the right, Cherry Pie, she's still a virgin (Oooh.)

Chita, meet the freak of the week-ah! (Week-ah!)

Phil’s homegirl, got Jack wanna keep her

But it’s not happenin’, neither! (No!)

Shake it like a seizure!, Hold up, let me spark this, take a breather, Breathe the reefer in my lungs. I got grapes, what you watchin’, son-sa?

It’s the Nutshack!
